form.label: Cisco IOS / IOS-XE - SOC Overview
form.description: Ingestion health, configuration changes, interface state, login events, and high-severity alerts for cisco:ios sourcetype. Not field-validated: panels use synthetic-equivalent fixture evidence only. Verify field availability before relying on panel counts.

search.query: index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" cisco_identifier="SYS" cisco_mnemonic="CONFIG_I" host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" cisco_identifier="SEC_LOGIN" cisco_mnemonic="LOGIN_FAILED" host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" (cisco_severity=0 OR cisco_severity=1 OR cisco_severity=2 OR cisco_severity=3) host=$host_tok$ | stats count

panel.title: Events by severity label over time

search.query: index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" host=$host_tok$ | eval sev_label=coalesce(severity_label, "unknown") | timechart count by sev_label

index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" cisco_identifier="SYS" cisco_mnemonic="CONFIG_I" host=$host_tok$ | eval who=coalesce(user, "unknown") | table _time host who config_source terminal cisco_message | sort -_time | head 100

index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" cisco_identifier="SEC_LOGIN" cisco_mnemonic IN (LOGIN_SUCCESS, LOGIN_FAILED) host=$host_tok$ | eval outcome=coalesce(login_result, cisco_mnemonic) | table _time host user src_ip dest_port outcome | sort -_time | head 100

index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" cisco_identifier IN (LINK, LINEPROTO) interface=* host=$host_tok$ | eval state=coalesce(interface_state, line_protocol_state, "unknown") | table _time host interface state cisco_identifier cisco_mnemonic | sort -_time | head 100

index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" (cisco_severity=0 OR cisco_severity=1 OR cisco_severity=2 OR cisco_severity=3) host=$host_tok$ | table _time host cisco_identifier cisco_severity severity_label cisco_mnemonic cisco_message | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: Top Cisco IOS event types by host

search.query: index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by host, cisco_identifier | sort -count | head 30

panel.title: SPL for manual triage (copy and run)
panel.html:
All Cisco IOS events drilldown:
index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" | table _time host cisco_identifier cisco_severity severity_label cisco_mnemonic cisco_message action signature user src_ip dest_port _raw

Login brute force (multiple failures from same IP):
index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" cisco_mnemonic="LOGIN_FAILED" | stats count by src_ip, host | where count > 5 | sort -count

Emergency/alert events (severity 0-1):
index=netops sourcetype="cisco:ios" (cisco_severity=0 OR cisco_severity=1) | table _time host cisco_identifier cisco_mnemonic severity_label cisco_message

Note: panels use synthetic-equivalent fixture evidence; not field-validated on live Cisco IOS sources.
